decision.title: Raised errors are kept by the item heap
decision.summary: sxml_item_heap_raise_error copies a raised error's code, description and source name into the item heap and retains its value, keeping one raised error per heap.

body.p: (task 0.8, header review). An error record holds borrowed views (), but fn:error and other native function bodies have no object of their own that outlives the call to keep a computed description or $err:value in. sxml_item_heap_raise_error copies the code, description and source name into the heap and retains the value; the record points there until the next error raised on that heap, sxml_item_heap_clear_raised_error, or finalization. One raised error per heap is enough: a catch clause retains $err:value (and makes its description an item) before evaluating anything else, and an error that propagates is the latest one. The function returns the error status itself so bodies can return it. A lazy sequence that must report its error again keeps its own copy and raises it again.
